parsed.post: New personal best! 0.974490. Increasing DEPTH to 8 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 significantly improved val_bpb from 0.986129. It seems a lower learning rate allows the deeper model to converge much more effectively within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing ASPECT_RATIO 64 with this new stable LR/depth config.
parsed.description: Testing ASPECT_RATIO 64 with the improved MATRIX_LR 0.03 and DEPTH 8 configuration.
